reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The sink expression is obj[1], which receives the value of bar. Tracing the data flow: user input param flows into valuesList.add(param), then valuesList.remove(0) removes the first element ('safe'), leaving valuesList as ['param', 'moresafe']. The subsequent call valuesList.get(1) retrieves the second element, which is the user-controlled 'param'. Thus, the resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. The format call writes this tainted value directly to the HTTP response body without HTML encoding.

evidence.note: Data flow: param added to list, index 0 removed, then index 1 retrieved (which holds the original param)
